faqs.q1: How do I hire a worker on MpahMapu?
faqs.a1: Post a job request with details like category, location, and pay rate. Verified workers will apply instantly, and you can review their profiles and ratings before hiring.
faqs.q2: How does payment work on MpahMapu?
faqs.a2: All payments are processed securely through MTN Mobile Money (MoMo). Funds are released to workers upon job completion.
faqs.a3: Yes, every worker on MpahMapu undergoes ID verification before they can accept jobs, ensuring trust and safety for employers.
faqs.q4: What types of workers can I find on MpahMapu?
faqs.a4: MpahMapu offers workers across 15+ categories including waiters, cleaners, security guards, drivers, electricians, plumbers, gardeners, event staff, and more.
faqs.a5: MpahMapu currently operates primarily in Kigali, Rwanda, with plans to expand to other cities and provinces.

hero.desc: MpahMapu connects employers with ID-verified, rated workers across Rwanda - for events, cleaning, security, driving and more. Hired in minutes, paid via MoMo.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: MpahMapu was founded in Rwanda in 2025 after watching skilled workers struggle to find consistent work and employers scramble to find reliable help on short notice. The solution was simple: a platform that makes both sides fast, transparent, and safe.
story.p2: The name MpahMapu means "a group that comes together to work" in Kinyarwanda - which is exactly what we're building. A community where every job is done with pride and every worker is treated with respect.

hero.desc: We collect only what we need, protect it carefully, and never sell it. Here is exactly how your data is handled on MpahMapu.

hl1.title: What we collect
hl1.body: Name, phone number, ID document, location, and job history - only what's needed to run the platform.

hl2.title: How we protect it
hl2.body: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. ID documents are stored on isolated, access-controlled servers.

hl3.title: Who we share with
hl3.body: Only the other party in a confirmed job booking, and MoMo for payment processing. Never sold to advertisers.

hl4.title: Your right to delete
hl4.body: Request account deletion at any time. We remove your personal data within 30 days, except where law requires otherwise.

intro.summary_body: We use your name, phone, and ID to verify you and run the platform. Payments go through MoMo - we never touch your cash. We share your info only with the person you are working with, and only what they need. You can delete your account any time.

sec1.title: Information we collect
sec1.body: When you register, we collect your full name, phone number, and national ID number. Workers also submit a photo of their ID document for verification. When you use the platform we collect job history, ratings, and general location data (district level) to match you with nearby opportunities or workers. We do not collect precise GPS coordinates without your explicit consent.

sec2.title: How we use your information
sec2.body: We use your data to operate the platform: verifying identities, matching workers to jobs, processing MoMo payments, and displaying your rating to prospective employers or workers. We may also use aggregated, anonymised data to improve our matching algorithms and understand how the platform is used - this data cannot identify you individually.

sec3.title: Who we share your data with
sec3.body: When a job is confirmed, the employer can see the worker's name, photo, rating, and job category experience - and vice versa. Beyond this, we share data only with MTN MoMo for payment processing and, if legally required, with Rwandan law enforcement or regulatory authorities. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any third party for marketing purposes.

sec4.title: ID verification
sec4.body: Workers submit a national ID document during onboarding. This document is reviewed by our verification team and then stored in an encrypted, access-restricted environment. Only authorised MpahMapu staff can access raw ID documents, and only for the purpose of resolving disputes or meeting legal obligations. Verified status is displayed as a badge; the underlying document is never shared with employers.

sec5.title: MoMo and payment data
sec5.body: We store only the MoMo phone number associated with your account. Full transaction records are held by MTN MoMo under their own privacy policy. MpahMapu retains payment records (amount, date, job reference) for up to 7 years as required by Rwandan tax law.

sec6.title: Cookies and app analytics
sec6.body: Our web and mobile platforms use essential cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. We also use privacy-respecting analytics to understand which features are used and where the platform can be improved. Analytics data is aggregated and does not identify individual users. You can disable non-essential cookies in your device or browser settings.

sec7.title: Data retention
sec7.body: Active accounts: data is retained as long as your account is open. Deleted accounts: personal data is removed within 30 days of deletion, except for transaction records (7 years, legal requirement) and data relevant to unresolved disputes. Anonymised, aggregated data may be retained indefinitely.

sec8.title: Your rights
sec8.body: Under Rwandan law and in the spirit of fair data practice, you have the right to access a copy of your personal data, correct inaccurate information, request deletion of your account and data, and object to certain processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact privacy@mpahmapu.com or use the in-app support form. We will respond within 10 business days.

sec9.title: Security
sec9.body: We use TLS encryption for all data in transit, AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest, and strict access controls so that only the staff who need data to do their jobs can access it. We conduct regular internal security reviews. If a breach occurs that affects your data, we will notify you within 72 hours and report it to the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA) as required.

sec10.title: Changes to this policy
sec10.body: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in the law or the platform. If changes are material, we will notify you via SMS or in-app notification at least 7 days before they take effect. Continued use of MpahMapu after that date constitutes acceptance.

sec11.title: Contact us
sec11.body: For privacy questions, data requests, or to report a concern, contact our data team at privacy@mpahmapu.com. For general queries use legal@mpahmapu.com or the contact form on our website.

hero.desc: These terms govern your use of MpahMapu as a worker or employer. Please read them carefully before creating an account.

intro.summary_body: MpahMapu connects workers and employers in Rwanda. You own your work and your earnings. We handle trust, verification, and MoMo payments. Be honest, be respectful, show up on time.

sec1.title: Acceptance of terms
sec1.body: By creating an account or using MpahMapu - whether as a worker or an employer - you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after any change means you accept the revised terms.

sec2.title: Who can use MpahMapu
sec2.body: You must be at least 18 years old and legally permitted to work or hire in Rwanda to create an account. Workers must complete ID verification before accepting jobs. Employers must provide accurate business or personal details when posting jobs. Accounts are non-transferable.

sec3.title: Posting and accepting jobs
sec3.body: Employers are responsible for the accuracy of every job post - including location, pay rate, category, and duration. Workers accept jobs based on that information; material misrepresentation may result in account suspension. Workers must complete accepted jobs or cancel with adequate notice. Repeated no-shows may result in removal from the platform.

sec4.title: Payments via MoMo
sec4.body: All payments are processed through MTN Mobile Money (MoMo). Employers are charged the agreed rate plus the MpahMapu service fee at the time of job confirmation. Funds are released to workers upon job completion. MpahMapu does not hold funds for longer than necessary and is not responsible for delays caused by MoMo's own processing times.

sec5.title: Ratings and conduct
sec5.body: Both workers and employers can be rated after each completed job. Ratings must reflect genuine experience. Fraudulent, retaliatory, or coerced reviews violate these terms and may be removed. All users are expected to communicate respectfully; harassment, discrimination, or abuse of any kind will result in permanent account removal.

sec6.title: Disputes and refunds
sec6.body: If a dispute arises - for example, a job was not completed as agreed - either party can raise a claim within 48 hours of the job end time. MpahMapu will review available evidence and make a binding decision. Refunds, where applicable, are processed back via MoMo within 3–5 business days.

sec7.title: Prohibited uses
sec7.body: You may not use MpahMapu to solicit workers off-platform to avoid fees, post illegal or hazardous work, collect personal data from other users without consent, or attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or interfere with the platform. Violations may result in immediate account termination and, where applicable, legal action.

sec8.title: Limitation of liability
sec8.body: MpahMapu is a marketplace and is not the employer or employee of any party. We do not guarantee the quality of work performed, the conduct of any user, or the availability of jobs. To the maximum extent permitted by Rwandan law, MpahMapu's liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid to us in the 30 days preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

sec9.title: Governing law
sec9.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda. Any disputes that cannot be resolved through MpahMapu's internal process will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Rwanda.

sec10.title: Contact
sec10.body: Questions about these terms? Reach us at legal@mpahmapu.com or through the contact form on our website. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

owner_help.faq1_a: Your payment is locked in escrow as soon as you confirm a booking. It is only released to the worker after you mark the job complete. You have 24 hours post-completion to raise a dispute.
owner_help.faq2_q: How do I raise a dispute?
owner_help.faq2_a: Go to the relevant completed job and click "Raise Dispute". Our team reviews all disputes within 2 business hours and will contact both parties.
owner_help.faq3_a: Yes. Free cancellation is available up to 2 hours before the scheduled start time. Late cancellations may incur a 10% fee to compensate the worker.
owner_help.faq4_a: All workers on MpahMapu go through ID verification and reference checks before being listed on the platform. Verified badges indicate completed checks.
owner_help.faq5_a: We currently support MTN MoMo and Airtel Money. Bank transfers are coming soon.

seeker_help.faq1_a: Your earnings are held in escrow when a job starts and are released directly to your wallet as soon as the employer marks the job complete. You can transfer wallet funds to your MTN MoMo or Airtel Money account anytime.
seeker_help.faq2_a: A commission is deducted from worker earnings to run the service, verify users and process payments — the exact rate is set by MpahMapu and shown before you accept a job.
seeker_help.faq3_a: Make sure your profile details, specialties, education, and district are complete. Employers can find you in 'Browse Workers' or you can apply to open jobs listed in the marketplace.
seeker_help.faq4_a: Once you finish the job, ask the employer to scan your worker badge or mark the job complete from their dashboard to release your payout.
seeker_help.faq5_q: What happens if there is a dispute?
seeker_help.faq5_a: If an employer refuses to release payment or opens a dispute, our support team reviews the case within 2 hours. We will contact both parties to resolve the issue based on work evidence.

escrow.overview: Here at MpahMapu, we operate a fully automated secure escrow framework. For every gig booked, the funds are instantly reserved from the employer's wallet balance. This guarantees to the gig worker that their time and effort are financially secured before they even travel to the job site. The rate is calculated as rate times hours times number of workers plus a 5% escrow handling charge.
escrow.process: Once you click 'Book Now', the system processes the request at {time} and freezes the total value. The funds remain in a pending escrow state during the entire shift. After the worker completes the task, they present their QR badge to the employer. Scanning the badge or clicking 'Mark Complete' triggers the instant payout release.
escrow.guidelines: All escrow funds are subject to our strict verification policy. Employers have up to 24 hours after completion to inspect the quality of work. If a dispute is raised, the funds will remain frozen until our admin support team verifies the case evidence and makes a final decision.

seeker.overview: As a worker, your pay is locked safely in escrow the moment an employer books you — so your earnings are guaranteed before you even travel to the job. You never chase an employer for money.
seeker.process: The funds stay held for the whole shift. When you finish, the employer scans your QR badge or taps 'Mark Complete', and the payment is released straight to your MpahMapu wallet, ready to withdraw.

public.overview: Escrow protects both sides. When an employer books a worker, the full amount is locked in a secure holding account so the worker knows the money is guaranteed and the employer knows it's only released for completed work.
public.process: The funds stay frozen during the job. Once the work is confirmed complete — by scanning the worker's QR badge or tapping 'Mark Complete' — the payment is released to the worker's wallet instantly.

payout.overview: You can withdraw your available MpahMapu wallet balance to Mobile Money at any time.
payout.process: Open your Wallet, tap 'Withdraw', enter the amount and your MTN MoMo or Airtel Money number, then confirm. The funds are sent to your mobile money account, usually within minutes.
payout.guidelines: Double-check the amount and the phone number before confirming. If a withdrawal doesn't arrive, check its status in your wallet transactions or contact support and we'll trace it.

seeker.overview: Your earnings land in your MpahMapu wallet after each completed job — you keep your share after the platform commission, and the exact amount is shown before you accept. From there you can cash out to Mobile Money whenever you like.

owner.overview: Any spare balance in your employer wallet — for example a refund from a cancelled job or a top-up you didn't use — can be withdrawn back to your Mobile Money account.

refund.overview: We understand that plans can change, which is why MpahMapu provides a transparent refund procedure. If a job is canceled under valid terms, the frozen escrow balance is immediately credited back to the employer's wallet. Refunds are handled in real-time, ensuring your cash flow remains fluid.
refund.process: To request a refund, navigate to your Payments tab, select the HELD transaction, and click 'Request Refund'. For open bookings, cancellations made more than 2 hours before the start time are fully refunded. Cancellations within the 2-hour window incur a small 10% worker compensation fee.
refund.guidelines: Any refund requests filed after the work has commenced are audited by support. Our team evaluates the chat timeline, work logs, and user reports. Once approved, the funds show up in your wallet balance, which you can withdraw via MTN MoMo or Airtel Money.

seeker.overview: As a worker you don't request refunds — your pay is protected in escrow. In fact, if an employer cancels late (within 2 hours of the start), you receive a 10% compensation fee for the short notice.
seeker.process: If a booking is cancelled late or a dispute is decided in your favour, any compensation is credited to your MpahMapu wallet, and you can withdraw it via MTN MoMo or Airtel Money.

public.overview: Refunds protect both sides. If a booking is cancelled within policy, the employer's escrow is returned to their wallet; if it's cancelled at the last minute, the worker is compensated for the short notice.

verify.overview: Safety and reliability are our highest priorities. Every service seeker and worker on MpahMapu undergoes a rigorous identity verification process before they can interact on the platform. This builds a high-trust community of verified professionals in Kigali.
verify.process: During registration, workers upload their National ID card, submit police clearance reports, and provide references from past employers. Our admin team reviews each application within 24 hours. Verified users receive a checkmark badge on their profile.
verify.guidelines: We continuously monitor user ratings. If a worker receives reviews below 3.5 stars, their account is put under review. Background checks are re-audited biannually. Any violation of our community standards results in immediate badge suspension.

owner.overview: Every worker on MpahMapu is ID-verified before they can be hired, so you can trust who you invite. Look for the verified badge on a worker's profile.
owner.process: To confirm a specific worker, scan the QR code on their badge or enter their badge ID on the verify page. You'll instantly see whether they're a genuine, active worker.

public.overview: Safety is our top priority: every worker passes ID verification and reference checks before joining, and each one carries a scannable verified badge so employers know exactly who they're hiring.

fee.overview: To sustain our high-speed transaction infrastructure and safety check systems, MpahMapu charges a service fee. This fee allows us to provide verified profiles, process MTN MoMo transactions instantly, and offer live support mediation.
fee.process: Workers are charged a service commission on their gross earnings. The exact rate is set by MpahMapu and shown before you accept a job and on your payout, so you always know what reaches your wallet. Employers pay a small escrow service fee at booking, shown before they confirm.
fee.guidelines: All platform fee deductions are displayed clearly on the invoice under your My Earnings tab. The service fee is non-refundable as it covers payment processor costs and system overhead. Detailed fee receipts are emailed for accounting.

owner.process: As an employer you pay only a 5% escrow handling fee on top of the workers' agreed amount, shown clearly before you confirm. For example, on a 10,000 RWF job you pay 10,500 RWF total. There are no other charges to hire.

seeker.process: As a worker, a service commission is deducted from your earnings. The exact rate and your take-home amount are always shown before you accept a job, so there are no surprises at payout.

job.overview: MpahMapu connects hundreds of skilled gig workers with local businesses and households in Kigali. Getting jobs is simple when your profile stands out. Keep your specialties, hourly rates, and working hours updated to match employer requests.
job.process: When employers need workers, they can post a job in the marketplace or browse verified profiles. You can search the marketplace, view hourly rates, and apply. Once an employer accepts your application, the job starts on the selected date.
job.guidelines: Workers should only apply to jobs they are fully qualified to perform. Arriving late or failing to show up without 24 hours notice will negatively impact your rating and may lead to temporary account suspension. Always communicate via chat.

owner.overview: Need to hire? Posting a job on MpahMapu takes just a few taps. Pick a category, set the date, location, number of workers and the rate, and verified workers nearby are notified right away.
owner.process: Tap 'Post a Job', fill in the details, and fund the escrow with your wallet, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money or card. Nearby verified workers can apply, or you can invite one directly with 'Hire Now' and review applicants before accepting.

public.overview: MpahMapu connects people who need work done with verified local workers across Rwanda. Sign up as a Worker to get hired for gigs, or as an Employer to post jobs and hire — you can even post a first job as a guest.

complete.overview: Marking a job complete is the final step in the MpahMapu workflow. This action tells the smart contract systems that the agreed work has been finished successfully and it is time to release the funds to the worker.
complete.process: Upon finishing your shift, present your worker QR code badge to the employer. They will scan it using their phone camera, or they can click 'Mark Complete' on their dashboard. Payout is processed instantly and reflects in your earnings.
complete.guidelines: Always ensure the employer completes the job on-site. If they forget, send a polite message via chat. If the employer refuses to mark completion despite work being done, do not worry; contact BazaBot support to submit work proof.

owner.overview: Marking a job complete is how you release the escrowed payment to the worker. It's the final step, done once you're satisfied the agreed work is finished.
owner.process: After the worker verifies completion with their QR badge, open the job on your dashboard and tap 'Mark Complete' — or scan their badge. The payment is released to the worker instantly, and you can then leave a rating.

dispute.overview: While we strive for perfect gig experiences, disagreements can sometimes happen. MpahMapu has a dedicated dispute mediation department to handle conflicts regarding quality of work, hours completed, or payment releases.
dispute.process: To open a dispute, go to the job page and click 'Raise Dispute'. You will be asked to upload evidence, such as photos of the finished work, chat screenshots, or time logs. Our support team is notified and freezes the escrow balance.
dispute.guidelines: Dispute reviews begin within 2 business hours. Our agents contact both the employer and the worker to hear both sides. Decisions are made impartially based on platform guidelines and submitted proof, and funds are distributed accordingly.

fallback.overview: I could not find a precise answer to that specific question.
fallback.process: You can rephrase it, or ask me about jobs, workers, payments, escrow, fees or verification — I can help with those.
fallback.guidelines: If you would prefer a person, just say "talk to a live agent" and I will connect you.
